testEffect: Removing the `toThrow(RangeError)` assertion (for example calling `applyDiscount(100, 101)` inside a try/catch with nothing asserted) would leave nothing checking that an invalid percent is actually rejected.
productionEffect: Removing the `if (percent < 0 || percent > 100) throw ...` guard from `applyDiscount` is expected to fail this test as written, since it would no longer throw; with the assertion removed as described above, that same change to `applyDiscount` would go undetected.
